claims.text: Alila Manggis is a seaside resort in Manggis, East Bali, set amid a coconut grove between the sea and Mount Agung.

findings.quote: Alila Manggis is a secluded, stylish seaside resort in Manggis, East Bali.
findings.note: Establishes the seaside resort in Manggis, East Bali.

findings.quote: Set amid a coconut grove, the resort nestles between the sea and the majestic Mount Agung, Bali’s most sacred mountain.
findings.note: Establishes the coconut grove setting between the sea and Mount Agung.

claims.text: The resort's design is a contemporary interpretation of traditional Balinese architecture.

findings.quote: A contemporary interpretation of traditional Balinese architecture is artfully combined with modern amenities
findings.note: Directly states the design approach.

claims.text: The Seaside King Suite is the resort's largest accommodation.

findings.quote: Go for the Seaside King Suite, the resort’s largest and most sophisticated dwelling at 1,220 square feet.
findings.note: Names the Seaside King Suite as the largest accommodation.

claims.text: Deluxe Rooms are on the upper floor, with a private balcony and daybed looking across the coconut grove, pool and sea.

findings.quote: Our 34 SQM Deluxe Room is located on the upper floor and offers the best views across the coconut grove, swimming pool, and sea.
findings.note: Covers the upper floor and the views across the grove, pool and sea.

findings.quote: Private balcony with daybed
findings.note: Covers the balcony with daybed listed for the Deluxe rooms.

claims.text: Seasalt's signature meal is the Megibung, a traditional East Bali shared feast served on a carved timber stand called the Dulang.

findings.quote: Savour the ceremony and ritual behind Seasalt’s signature meal, the Megibung.
findings.note: Establishes the Megibung as Seasalt's signature meal.

findings.quote: In the customary tradition of sharing food with friends and family during village festivals and ceremonies in East Bali, choose from a multitude of dishes served on a carved timber stand called the Dulang.
findings.note: Covers the East Bali sharing tradition and the Dulang timber stand.

claims.text: Seasalt serves Indonesian and Western dishes in a traditional pavilion set on a lotus pond.

findings.quote: Dine on vibrant Indonesian and Western flavours in a traditional pavilion set on a lotus pond at Seasalt, which offers all-day dining.
findings.note: Covers the cuisine, the pavilion and the lotus pond.

claims.text: The Flavors of East Bali cooking experience starts with picking ingredients in the resort's garden and cooking with a chef using the traditional firewood method.

findings.quote: Guests will participate in on hands-on cooking with Chef at the garden, starting with picking out the ingredients to cooking them together using the traditional firewood method.
findings.note: Covers picking ingredients, cooking with the chef and the firewood method.

findings.quote: Wander through the resort's lush organic garden
findings.note: Confirms the garden is the resort's own.

claims.text: The Caves and Crystals experience visits the Goa Lawah bat cave temple and the salt pans of Kusamba, where sea salt is still harvested by hand.

findings.quote: Discover the enchanting Goa Lawah, Bali’s sacred Bat Cave, just minutes from Alila Manggis.
findings.note: Covers the visit to the Goa Lawah bat cave.

findings.quote: Then continue to Kusamba’s coast, where sea salt is still harvested by hand in sunlit rituals passed down through generations.
findings.note: Covers Kusamba and the hand-harvested sea salt.

findings.quote: Walk through the salt pans, learn the steps from seawater to crystal
findings.note: Covers the salt pans.

claims.text: The Alila Leisure Concierge team tailors activities across five themes: Cultural Learning, Conscious Living, Active Spirits, Culinary Arts and Couple Celebration.

findings.quote: yours to explore with the guidance of our Alila Leisure Concierge team. Enhance your holiday with lifestyle activities tailored to individual interests across five themes:
findings.note: Covers the concierge team and the tailored activities across five themes.

findings.quote: Cultural Learning (love of history and artisanship), Conscious Living (wellness, environs and community), Active Spirits (outdoor sporting pursuits), Culinary Arts (cooking school and food trails) and Couple Celebration.
findings.note: Lists all five themes named in the claim.

claims.text: The resort follows a zero-waste policy and runs a coral reef conservation programme with a local diving operation.

findings.quote: the resort adheres to a zero-waste policy, conducts a coral reef conservation programme in partnership with a local diving operation
findings.note: Covers both the zero-waste policy and the coral reef programme.

claims.text: Tenganan village, known for its double-ikat Gringsing woven cloth, is near the resort.

findings.quote: Just near the resort, the village of Tenganan is renowned for its double-ikat or ‘Gringsing’ woven cloth.
findings.note: Covers Tenganan's proximity and its Gringsing cloth.

claims.text: All rooms and suites face the ocean, with views across the straits to Nusa Penida.

findings.quote: All rooms and suites face the ocean with clear views across the straits to Nusa Penida.
findings.note: Direct statement of the ocean-facing rooms and the Nusa Penida views.

claims.text: Rooms and suites are housed in traditional two-storey thatched Balinese pavilions angled to the beach.

findings.quote: Housed in traditional two-storey thatched Balinese pavilions, all 55 of our rooms and suites are angled to the beach
findings.note: Covers the pavilions and the angle to the beach.

claims.text: Spa Alila treatments take place in open-air bales facing the sea, in the shade of pandan groves.

findings.quote: Nestled within the shade of pandan groves and facing the endless sea, Spa Alila offers a sanctuary where nature and well-being meet. Treatments unfold in open-air bales
findings.note: Covers the open-air bales, the pandan grove shade and the sea-facing setting.

claims.text: Surya is a yoga shala overlooking the ocean on Bali's east coast, where the sun rises.

findings.quote: Aptly located overlooking the ocean along Bali’s east coast, where the sun rises, Surya comprises a 10m x 10m yoga shala.
findings.note: Covers every element of the claim.

claims.text: The Roots of Tenganan experience is a bike ride through rice fields to the Bali Aga village of Tenganan to meet master ikat weavers.

findings.quote: Cycle through emerald rice fields before entering this Bali Aga settlement
findings.note: Covers the bike ride through rice fields to the Bali Aga village.

findings.quote: speak with master ikat weavers
findings.note: Covers meeting the master ikat weavers.

claims.text: The resort is about a 90-minute drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport.

findings.quote: Located just 90 minutes’ drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport
findings.note: Directly states the 90-minute drive.
